problem.title: Continuation-connected family decomposition and stability critical manifold
problem.question: Determine the continuation-connected family decomposition of the Li--Li--Liao unequal-mass non-hierarchical periodic-orbit catalog and, for each connected family, compute the connected planar linear-stability critical manifold in mass space, classify its Floquet mechanisms and branch connections, and independently verify the qualitative critical events.
problem.scope: Planar linear Floquet stability for the frozen Li--Li--Liao unequal-mass non-hierarchical catalog and its branch-preserving continuations; not the general three-body problem, spatial stability, KAM stability, or a theorem of nonlinear stability.
problem.success_criterion: A solved release must support a new, continuation-resolved statement about family decomposition and/or the connected stability critical manifold, with mechanism-level classification, independent high-precision verification, adversarial falsification, frozen provenance, and a fresh novelty audit.
problem.baseline: Li, Li & Liao (2021), arXiv:2007.10184 / Science China Physics, Mechanics & Astronomy 64, 219511. The published 135,445-orbit catalog and its 13,315 stable labels are baseline facts, not ATLAS discoveries.

decision.summary: The stated v1 open problem is not solved. Post-audit evidence strongly constrains the geometry: the 620 coarse S/U cells form four mechanism-labeled tracks; rank-refinement found no surviving <1e-6 shooting singularity; a generic-chart adversarial bridge passed; ten lower +1 daughter candidates were found; and a secondary -1 fold candidate exists. Release is withheld because independent BigFloat critical-point truth, the exact organizer/critical graph, the hardest connectivity edges, daughter-branch topology, and final canonical/release closure remain unresolved.

gates.title: Independent critical-point truth
gates.criterion: Every headline Floquet mechanism must be independently localized and canonically verified at arbitrary precision with convergence and uncertainty evidence.

gates.title: Exact Floquet organizer/network geometry
gates.criterion: The full declared critical object must be a connected mechanism graph whose edges and organizers have explained geometry, uncertainty, and physical Floquet evidence.

gates.title: Family/sheet connectivity
gates.criterion: Family identity must survive rank-loss, reverse-continuation, path-diversity, and less-specialized chart attacks rather than relying on projected invariants or topology words.

gates.title: Release closure
gates.criterion: All declared components, verification classes, adversarial searches, hashes, paper inputs, and the release-date novelty audit must be frozen together before a solved release is authorized.

claims.statement: The frozen 0.001 mass-grid S/U boundary is organized into four macroscopic tracks whose 620 transition cells each exhibit exactly one endpoint-sign-changing smooth reduced-Floquet event; the event counts are 198 +1, 168 -1, and 254 trace collisions, with three coarse cross-mechanism adjacency junctions.
claims.method: Full frozen-catalog endpoint Floquet census and mass-space track association.
limitations: This is coarse-grid screening topology, not the final exact connected critical graph.

claims.statement: The strongest tested projected-invariant ambiguity is continuation-connected in both the Li shooting chart and an independent generic translation-reduced strict-periodic chart, while the 28 lowest first-stage shooting-rank candidates all move above the fixed 1e-6 suspicion ratio after tight correction.
claims.method: Bidirectional continuation in two formulations plus second-stage shooting-Jacobian singular-spectrum audit.
limitations: The globally worst MST links are not all certified; one hard edge remains unresolved and the full catalog connectedness claim is withheld.

claims.statement: The birth of the secondary stable lobe is consistent with a generic quadratic fold of the -1 event curve near masses (0.9957049987, 0.9742436529, 1), rather than necessarily a mixed +1/-1 spectral vertex.
claims.method: Float64 solve of P(-2)=0 and dP(-2)/dm2=0 with finite-derivative transversality/curvature checks.
limitations: The fold candidate has not been independently reproduced at BigFloat precision and a later high-level rerun missed its fixed float64 gate.

claims.statement: The lower +1 event admits ten distinct same-period generic periodic-orbit daughter candidates across the tested signed transverse amplitudes.
claims.method: Amplitude-constrained generic branch-switch solves using physical transverse Floquet directions with same-mass Li-parent comparison.
limitations: These are float64 screening candidates; a daughter family is not established until branch continuation and independent reproduction succeed.

blockers: Complete independent Julia BigFloat reproduction of the lower +1 and upper trace-collision critical representatives, then evaluate the corrected points canonically with convergence and uncertainty records.

Resolve the three coarse mechanism-junction neighborhoods by event-specific continuation; test the secondary -1 fold hypothesis and the two principal-lower +1/-1 junctions without assuming mixed vertices.

Certify the twenty globally worst MST links with adaptive continuation and attack every survivor with the generic chart/path diversity; the known hard edge (0.839,0.721,1)<->(0.838,0.721,1) is unresolved.
Continue at least one lower +1 daughter candidate into a branch and independently reproduce enough of it to determine whether it reconnects to the catalog sheet or forms a distinct branch.
Trace and freeze the exact connected critical graph with mechanism labels, organizer/end-point classifications, uncertainties, and physical canonical evidence.
Restore GitHub Actions runner availability: current main-branch scientific/CI jobs are not starting because the account reports a payment/spending-limit block.

Freeze the final evidence manifest, regenerate the manuscript from release claims, run adversarial hidden-component searches, and rerun the literature novelty audit immediately before any solved release.
known_limitations: Current critical-event and connectivity evidence is incomplete and therefore cannot support the solved claim.

The split BigFloat verifier and adaptive connectivity matrix are on main but their latest runs contain no scientific result because GitHub Actions did not allocate runners under the account billing/spending block.
The v1 stability scope is planar linear Floquet stability only; it does not imply spatial or nonlinear/KAM stability.
Negative literature searches are not proofs of novelty; the novelty audit is a release-time search firewall.
